metadata.expected_failure_reason: checker SIGSEGV (stack exhaustion) with an 8 MiB stack; cliff on moss-opt ~258 (Int) / ~250 (user type); depends on build flavor (moss-dev -O0 crashes near depth 40) and stack size.
